d: We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarter in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. d: Are you a people person with a passion for providing exceptional customer service? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you as a Guest Care Specialist at Gathern. As a Guest Care Specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring all guests have a positive and memorable experience during their interactions with our company.

In this role, you will serve as the main point of contact for guests, handle inquiries and resolve any issues or complaints in a timely and professional manner. You will also provide product recommendations, assist with bookings, and maintain accurate guest records. Additionally, you will collaborate with other team members to improve guest satisfaction and contribute to the overall success of the company.
If you are a friendly and organized individual who enjoys helping others, we would love to hear from you.
q: Ability to remain calm and professional in stressful situations.
Able to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays.
r: Provide exceptional customer service to all guests.
Act as the main point of contact for guest inquiries and ensure timely resolution of any issues or complaints.
Assist guests with booking reservations and provide product recommendations.
Maintain accurate guest records and update customer information as needed.
Collaborate with team members to improve guest satisfaction and contribute to the overall success of the company.
